title: BandingResult
description: Policy band classification result with hierarchical rule evaluation (BLACK → RED → AMBER → GREEN). Used for sharing policy, notification timing, and guardian alerts. Reference: ADR-0012e (k003e)

band.description: Assigned policy band after hierarchical rule evaluation

confidence.description: Confidence in band assignment (0.0-1.0). Lower confidence may trigger manual review.

reasons.description: Human-readable explanations for band assignment (e.g., 'Minor distress detected', 'Parent-child conflict')

rule_ids.description: Policy rule IDs that triggered this band (e.g., ['BLACK_RULE_1', 'RED_RULE_3'])

notify_guardian.description: Whether to send immediate notification to guardian (true for BLACK, RED bands)

escalate.description: Whether to escalate for human review (true for BLACK band or low confidence RED)

policy_action.description: P18 PolicyAction mapping for sharing control (optional, generated by policy engine)

allowed_spaces.description: Space IDs where content can be shared

sharing_delay.description: Delay in seconds before content becomes shareable

rollup_half_life.description: Time constant for memory rollup (shorter = faster consolidation)

notify_guardian.description: Redundant with top-level field, included for P18 compatibility
